verdict.rationale: Weave is a hosted LLM observability and evaluation service that stores user traces, inputs and outputs, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack does not document any such policy or control; it covers only tracing, evaluations, scorers, cost tracking, OTel ingestion and MCP access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
